notes.title: ⚓ Sailing Toward 1.0 – Permanent Price Drop to $5.99
notes.content:
The sea is restless, and so are we: 
Dreadline: Net Quota is steering toward 1.0 launch!
As part of that journey, we’re making a permanent price drop. From now on, the game will be just $5.99 no hooks, no bait-and-switch.

To everyone who already bought the game. Thank you. Your early support kept this leaky boat afloat, and we’re working on a way to properly compensate you. You’ll hear more on that soon.

When 1.0 arrives, expect more than just patched planks. We’re adding fresh content, polish, and a few surprises lurking beneath the waves. Bigger catches, nastier seas, and hats so fancy they might just distract you from certain doom.

Grab your friends, brace for the darkness, and get ready: the haul ahead is going to be our biggest yet.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/91568dfba3f42041dea4632330992b7184692def.jpg"]

Sincerly 

The Mana Brigade Dev Team

notes.title: 🌊 Dreadline Patch Notes - Ghastly Update 👻
notes.content:
Welcome aboard, fish freaks and horror heads!
We’ve netted a load of spooky improvements and fresh features for your next trip into the fog. Steven Seagull is still “working on himself” (or hiding?), but a new creepy arrival is ready to haunt your catch.


[hr][/hr]

👻 New Monster Feature
Sea Ghast Emerges - A spectral horror now roams the Ship Graveyard… Keep your eyes peeled, and be ready to run... Or swim 🌊

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/cd6a2e0a6d87e411c60bdc604efa6b12ea7896bb.jpg"]
[hr][/hr]

🎣 Gameplay & Systems
First-Person Animations - Watch your own hands panic as you fish, repair, and flail. ✋

Interactive Newspaper - A brand new 3D model you can click to read, perfect for catching up on the local news. 📰

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/2aa01b71922c0751c500e1fb8264a4da395debc5.png"]

Fish Rarity Display - Rarity is now shown when you catch a fish, so you know just how special (or cursed) it is. 🐟

Emote Camera - Emotes now zoom out to third-person for full dramatic effect. 🎭

Steam Deck Support - Fish from the comfort of your couch! 🎮

New Islands added - Explore some new islands and landmarks in Driftwood Bay! 👀


[hr][/hr]

🛠️ Fixes & Polish
Lighthouse Ambience - Loops correctly and syncs for everyone. 🌊

Fixed Island & Debris Colliders - No more ghost-boating through the scenery. 🏝️

Tentacle Visibility - Fixed (we think) so they can’t vanish into thin water. 🐙

Debris Syncing - Now all players see the same floating junk. ♻️

Tinkering Animation Fix - No more endless tinkering after repairs. 🔧

Silent Swimming - No footsteps while swimming or falling. 🏊

Lobby Death Bug - Players won’t randomly die when someone joins or leaves. 💀

Missing UI Sounds - Added hover sounds where they were missing. 🎚️

Shader Glitches - Patched for a smoother visual experience. 🎨


[hr][/hr]

🔊 Audio & VOIP
Death Chat - You can now gossip from beyond the grave. ☠️

VOIP Stability - Fewer cutouts, clearer screams. 🎤

Added Community music - "Ye Cod Father" by Phrieksho / Reali-tGlitch has been added to the radio 📻


[hr][/hr]

⚓ Quality of Life
Spectator Mode - Click to switch between players when spectating. 👀

Visible Spectator Head - You can now see your friends noggin yell at you from the grave. 💀

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/5e52f9299d77969263b1773fed72f2fe2dfc50da.png"]
[hr][/hr]


Thanks for sailing with us through these haunted waters! Your bug reports, cursed screenshots, and Steam reviews keep us rowing through the fog. If you’ve enjoyed the chaos, drop us a review and tell us what horrors you want to see next. 😄🎣

notes.title: Shark Week Special - Nom Nom Nom!! 🦈
notes.content:
🦈 Patch Notes – Shark Week Special
Welcome aboard, fish freaks and horror heads, we’ve got a big net full of fixes, features, and festive content to celebrate Shark Week. Whether you're here to dodge monsters or just wear silly hats, this one’s for you.


[hr][/hr]

🦑 New & Festive Content
🦈 Shark Hat Cosmetic A fin-tastic new cosmetic that players unlock only if they launch the game during Shark Week (July 18–26).

🧢 “Shark Bait” Title A special player title earned the same way,  log in during Shark Week to claim it.

🐟 Shark Spawns During Shark Week Special fish (sharks!) now spawn during the event period.

🧰 Special Fish Mechanic Backend system now supports limited-time fish spawns (used for Shark Week, and more in the future!).


[hr][/hr]

🛠️ Gameplay & Systems
Fish Balancing General balancing pass on fish behavior and economy.

Redesigned Harbor (Gallows Wharf) Tutorial zone has received a full makeover: more lived-in atmosphere, better layout, and environmental storytelling.

Fishing Spot Logic Fixes

Only the host could access tutorial fishing spots, *fixed.

Fishing spots now consistently activated as expected.

Added checks to ensure islands spawn fishing spots properly.


[hr][/hr]

🪛 Bug Fixes
Wardrobe Right Click Issue Fixed player movement freezing when right-clicking to exit the wardrobe.

Only Host Could Animate Wardrobe Now synced across clients.

Signs Clipping Through Boat Cleaned up sign placement.

Conger Eel Bug This slippery fella should behave better now.

Boaty McBoat Upgrader Achievement Now unlocks properly for all players, not just the host.

Collision Fixes

Players could get stuck on the crane, fixed with box colliders.

Layer & Map Bugs Fixed house/town layer map issues and mansion map layers.

Debris Sync Debris now correctly syncs position between clients.

Engine Animation Bug Missing humming parts now hum like they should.

Rubber Duck Fix Reattached the duck’s audio and harbor position.

VOIP Echo Reduced spooky feedback from the void. - No more death rooms, we're all in this together, dead or alive!

Disable Input UI Tidied up rogue UI elements.


[hr][/hr]

🎨 Art & Cosmetics
Shark Hat Cosmetic (again cause it rules) Nom Nom Nom!

Double Door It's real. It’s fixed. We don’t talk about it. You saw nothing. 👀

Hat Fixes Various polish on hats and accessories.

Wrong Logo in Tutorial Corrected the Mana Brigade logo across tutorial areas.

New Cosmetic Entries in Credits Alcode and Jinxy added to credits. Thanks for the help 💞

House Map Layer & Other Art Bugs Smoothed out visuals around housing areas.


[hr][/hr]

🧪 Multiplayer
Block Option You're now able to kick and ban players as the host, through the TAB menu!

Remove All Bans Option Settings menu now supports clearing all bans. (if you “accidentally” banned your friends)


[hr][/hr]


Let us know what you think and don’t forget to log in during Shark Week to unlock the exclusive gear! 🦈💬 Join the Discord, and drop your feedback! Or even better, join the fun and catch some fish and get a shark hat😄

notes.title: ⚓Patch Notes - 250624⚓
notes.content:
🎙️ Hey hey, haunted anglers!
We’ve been untangling more bugs and cleaning the deck after the last few chaotic voyages. This patch is a smaller one, but it's all about quality-of-life and weird fish behavior — the wiggling has been stopped, the wardrobe now makes satisfying sounds, and the lobby won't instantly betray you.
We're listening, tweaking, and slowly making the seas a little smoother (and louder).
[hr][/hr]🔧 What’s New
🐟 Fish no longer jitter and spasm on the boat
Turns out frozen fish don’t flop.

❄️ Inventory fish now freeze in place
They stay right where you left them — no more accidental cannonballing.

💀 Lobby no longer kills the entire crew when one player leaves
Who knew the lobby wasn’t supposed to be the final boss?

🔊 Base VOIP volume increased
You can now hear your crewmates panic a little more clearly.

🧭 Codfather “heads up” ping
A radar ping now plays when he's locked on to your scent — RUN.

🛍️ UI sounds added

Missing hover sounds filled in

Wardrobe now opens and closes with actual sound. Satisfying.
[hr][/hr]🌊 Thanks for sailing with us
We’re keeping the chaos alive, but hopefully a little less fish-floppy. Your bug reports, screams, and cursed screenshots help us keep making Dreadline better — one haunted harpoon at a time.

See you out there, and remember: frozen fish don’t scream.

notes.title: ⚓Patch Notes - 250619⚓
notes.content:
Ahoy again, dredgers of the deep!

We've been swimming through your feedback and squashing some of the slipperiest bugs yet. From phantom boats clipping through islands to mysterious shop upgrades with zero explanation — this patch should smooth out some of the roughest waters.

Thanks to everyone who's been testing, breaking, and occasionally screaming their way through Dreadline — you're helping us reel in the chaos, one patch at a time.


🛥️ Boat & World Interaction
No more sailing through solid matter! The boat will now properly collide with islands. (Turns out, player boat shouldn’t be ghost ships.)
[hr][/hr]🕰️ UI & Visual Updates
Clock visual overhaul
Both the HUD and the ship’s in-game clock got a clarity pass.
Time to actually know what time it is.

Shop hover-over text added
Now you can see what upgrades do before buying them.
Imagine that!

Float rods moved slightly
We nudged them to the right — should make clicking the correct rod way easier.
(Muscle memory: updated.)
[hr][/hr]🐛 Crash Reporting Improvements
Crash reports now auto-send (with permission)
This helps us track down and squash more bugs moving forward.
Thanks for suffering for science!





We're still hunting a few deep-sea bugs (and yes, some fish still think they're birds), but your reports are helping us patch faster than ever.

Keep sharing what you find, Wishlist the game if you haven’t already, and as always — join the Discord to help out shape the games future! We're counting on you! 💖

Now get back out there and catch something weird. 🎣

notes.title: Day one Patch
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve been going through your feedback from day one — thank you so much for playing and sharing your thoughts!

This patch includes some early tweaks to help fine-tune that dreadful feeling we’re aiming for.
We really appreciate all the reviews, bug reports, and chaos — it’s helping us shape this game into something special.

Thanks for being part of the journey 💙


🦈 Codfather Adjustments
Codfather aggression rebalanced

Aggro builds up 76% slower than before.

Aggro decays 3x faster by before, making it easier to shake him off... at first.

Speed needed to trigger aggro lowered by 50%

But beware — over your first 10 days, his temper increases...

Spawning behavior improved

Codfather will no longer appear directly in front of the boat — giving you a fair chance to escape.

He now spawns 75% farther away, From 200 → 350 units for more breathing room.

Minimap improvements

Codfather now appears on the minimap when aggroed.

Movement behavior updated

Codfather moves 25% slower when close to the boat, giving tight escapes a better shot.
[hr][/hr]🛥️ Boat Handling & Performance
Base speed increased by 37.5%

From 8 → 11. Zoom zoom.

Steering responsiveness increased by 50%

From 10 → 15. Smoother turns, better panic slides.

Client handling now properly synced

Steering and speed should feel consistent across host and clients. No more sluggish turns for passengers!
[hr][/hr]🗺️ Navigation & Radar
Main island now visible on the minimap

Makes it easier to orient yourself and your crewmates when returning from the fog.
[hr][/hr]🐛 Known Issues
Fish physics are still slippery.
Caught fish may launch, slide, or clip through the boat like they’ve got unfinished business. We're wrangling it!

Stability issues on respawn.
Some players experience occasional crashes or flow-breaking glitches, especially during respawn or transitions.

We're actively working on these! If you encounter any crashes, please send us your Player.log — it really helps us track these down. 

Location of the player log is at C:\\Users\\USER\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Mana Brigade\\DreadLine\\Player.log !

notes.title: Dreadline: Net Quota is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey Crewmates!
The engine's smoking, the fish are cursed, and you're deep in debt — Dreadline: Net Quota is officially LIVE in Early Access on Steam!

Grab your 2–6 player crew and plunge into co-op chaos, where every run is a mess of sea monsters, engine breakdowns, and arguments over fuel (and hats).

We didn’t manage to fit everything we wanted into the game for Early Access—there’s still more we’re dying to add. As a bit of a “sorry” (and a thank-you), we’re launching with a 
Launch Discount: 40% off for two weeks!
This is just the start. We’re going to keep building, patching, and adding the weird stuff we couldn’t squeeze in yet—and your feedback on Discord is going to help shape all of it.

So if you want to help steer this chaotic ship (or at least keep it afloat), now’s the time to jump in.


❗ Note: We’ve temporarily taken down the demo to focus on improving the full game. Thanks for your patience and understanding!

notes.title: Release notes
notes.content:
⚓ Dreadline Patch Notes"Yes, there's a goat."[hr][/hr]🛠️ Gameplay Improvements
You can now steer and repair even while holding fishing rods or gear. Multi-tasking unlocked!

Ladders added to boats and harbors! Save yourself if your crew won’t.

Float fishing no longer locks you in place — feel free to panic and move.

Boat now stops when all players jump off. Seems fair.

Boat now steers properly in reverse. Finally.

Boat is 30% faster. Speed is safety... Sometimes.

Days are 50% longer. Enjoy the calm. Fear the dark.
[hr][/hr]🧭 UI & Clarity Improvements
New mini-map icon for the boat — now shows which way you’re facing.

Lighthouse icons now visible on map. Find your way home.

Safe zones are now clearly indicated. You’ll know when you're safe.

Clock now stops at lighthouses. Time finally respects you.

Shop sliders no longer draggable. Less UI rage.

Settings sliders easier to grab. Your mouse thanks you.

Updated splash screen. It's pretty now!

Blue highlight removed from boat inventory sign. Clean.
[hr][/hr]🧢 Cosmetics & Achievements
Achievements are in! Some unlock hats and titles. Go fish for glory!

Hover-over hints added to hats and titles. Unlocking clues included!
[hr][/hr]🧼 Bugs, Fixes & Polish
VOIP fixes:

More stable.

Press F1 to reset voice.

Death chat now works. Ghost talk returns.

Shop and selling bugs fixed. You now get paid correctly.

Boat inventory got extra collisions. Fish shouldn't fall through the floor anymore!

Fish physics:

Oarfish no longer freaks out.

Conger eel calmed down.

No more fish on game reset.

Players can now explore islands while docked. Stretch those legs.

Biome circle syncing fixed. Colors too!

Goat sync. That’s it. That’s the note.

Trash cleanup improved:

Cleared on game restart.

Cleared when tossed into the ocean.

Extra in-game signs added:

“Leave fish in the boat”

“How to drive”-note

“Return your rods!”

VSync is now functional. Smoothness achieved.
[hr][/hr]🐛 Known Issues
(Yes, we see them. Yes, we’re working on them.)

Some resolutions mess with the UI. If buttons start doing parkour, try another res.

Fishes may still fly off the boat. We call it... skyfishing.

VOIP can get laggy.

Temporary fix: press F1 to reset.

Dropping a fish from your rod can launch it into orbit.

Pro tip: crouch and drop until we sort it out.

Fish may jitter on deck for other players. They’re just excited.

Boat can clip into islands when lag collides with physics.

Dock with care.

Tabs in the upgrades menu don’t always visually switch. Functionally there, visually confused.

VOIP is currently fully stereo.

3D positional audio coming soon™.

Some rare crashes still exist.

If it happens to you, please send us your Player.log file!

📂 C:\\Users\\\[YourName]\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Mana Brigade\\DreadLine

Tentacle enemy may turn invisible.

It’s either a bug or a feature. We’re not sure yet.

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – 250611
notes.content:
Hey crew! 🌊

We’ve got a fresh batch of fixes and improvements coming in hot — thanks again to everyone who's been playing, testing, and helping us find these weird little gremlins. Here's what's changed:
[hr][/hr]🟢 Safezone HUD Update
We’ve cleaned up the HUD so it’s clearer when you’re in a safe zone.
When you're here, you can breathe easy — time won’t run out on you!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/07e60300ef068e160d9cd4bc772fcdaeb79981dd.png"]
💀 Player List – Now With More Death
You should now see your glorious (or tragic) fate reflected in the player list.
Dead? It’ll say so. Alive? Keep it that way.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/c87dce3ee748a911f2ec9935824e9da9585c4eab.png"]
✅ To-Do List!
We've added a handy To-Do List on your HUD!
Now you and your crew can keep track of objectives without yelling over each other (…but feel free to yell anyway).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/fff61dfcb74fb164c06a2c384c049cd42a73d484.png"]
🌊 Ocean Surface Tweaks
The ocean's gotten a tiny visual upgrade — nothing major, just a bit more detail to help it feel alive. Or maybe it's just hungry. Who knows.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/09c5ab1cb864d78d71f5dc699544982a350cccfd.gif"]
🚤 Lobby Name = Boat Name
Typing in the lobby name from the main menu?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/c318dfc523b754736422dabd8691df1b82e075ef.png"]

[hr][/hr]
That’s it for now — thanks again for sticking with us, and for all the bug reports, chaos, and cursed fish energy. More updates soon!

❤️
— The Dreadline Team

notes.title: 🎣 Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey fishers! 🐟

We’ve reeled in a couple of slippery bugs that managed to flop their way into the build:

🪣 Starter Area Crash Fix
Some of you discovered that casting a line in the starter area as a non-host caused the whole game to go belly-up.
Turns out, we forgot to tell the game there was fresh trash to be found there… whoops! 😅 That’s sorted now — cast away without fear!

🔌 Connection Stability
We’ve tightened up the bolts on session disconnects and reconnects. Things should feel a lot more stable now when hopping back into a crew.

Thanks again for reporting these, and for being part of the chaos with us. Keep the bug reports coming — and maybe a few fish, too.


❤️
— The Dreadline Team

notes.title: 🧪Last Playtest is LIVE – Test it like it’s hot 🔥
notes.content:
Hey fishers, survivors, and brave boaters!

We’ve been hard at work gutting bugs, refining systems, and stuffing the seas with new features. This update is one of our biggest yet, and it's packed with a TON of content for you to explore and test out.

🌟 What’s New

 New HUD for a cleaner, more intuitive experience
 Updated engine UI for better clarity
 Emote wheel – show off your best dance moves!
 Player menu – see who’s online and who’s... not alive
 Improved day/night visuals and clear mid-day indicators
 Onboating (yes, it’s a thing now)
 You can now drown (good luck!)
 Renamed fishing types: Catch = Float, Throw = Cast
 Fishing loot system overhaul – location, gear, and rarity matter
 Tentacles slap now instead of instant kill
 Tentacle visibility properly synced
 You can’t fish in the engine room anymore (sorry, engine fish)
 No more sleeping at sunrise – pull your weight!
 Group sleep system – wait for your crew
 Sleep feedback when quota is cleared
 Crouching added – sneak sneak
 New audio cues for rare fish
 Mouths move when yelling (yes, really)
 Eye-tracking – characters now glance at others
 Spectate cam has proper audio
 VOIP muffled behind obstacles (realistic audio!)
 Biome-specific ambiance improvements
 Radio in the cabin – go twist the dial
 Story-rich island updates
 Lighthouse harbors – sell, sleep, and respawn in new places
 Global and local maps now available
 Danger scaling across the map with new generation tech
 Boat sway synced across all players
 Boat now stops correctly when engine shuts off
 Audio warnings before engine failure
 Engine won’t break while idle
 Codfather now breaks your boat (he’s hangry)
 Improved boat physics and unsticking
 Full character customization – hats, bodies, titles!
 Going too far from the boat? You’ll die now.
 Dead = no name above your body
 Save your drowning friends with the Life Buoy
 In-game TV added for guidance
 New fish: say hi to the Perch!
 Fish rarity + new sell values
 Goofy, slimy fish visuals
 Achievement system preview – check out the locked cosmetics!


🛠️ Fixes & Improvements

 Main menu buttons fixed
 Clock visuals cleaned up
 Sleep no longer kills your audio
 Maps easier to use
 Interaction prompts when hands are full
 Fishing spots now work consistently
 Spectate cam now shows fish
 Fishing line and bobber behave properly
 Fish no longer have four eyes (really)
 Boat won’t drive off on respawn
 Ghost boats through islands = gone
 Engine-off now stops the boat
 Ignition light now behaves
 Can host/join after disconnect again
 We (really) think we fixed the walk-backwards bug
 Engine room lighting fixed
 No fail states at night in harbors or lighthouses


💀 Retired (For Now)

 Spearfishing
 Steven Seagull


That’s everything for this update! We’re super excited for you to try it all out. Your feedback continues to shape the game, and we can’t thank you enough for being part of the journey. Now get out there, catch some fish, and maybe dodge a tentacle or two. 🐙🎣

Stay safe on the seas,
Mana Brigade

notes.title: FINAL PLAYTEST UPDATE: PATCHES, PERILS, AND A QUESTION ABOUT BLOOD
notes.content:
The end is near… of the playtests, that is.

Mr. S.Hark’s ledger is thicker than ever, and you’ve all done your part  hauling in monsters, breaking our code (and boats), and giving us feedback that’s reshaped the entire game.

This patch is a love letter, if love letters came covered in fish guts and tentacle bruises. A lot of what’s below? That’s because you asked for it. Some of it? You didn’t. We did it anyway.

🧪 FINAL PLAYTEST RUNS MAY 23–25
 This is it — the last time to set sail before the storm hits. Bring friends. Bring questions. Bring bait.

And one thing before you go 🩸
Should we add blood and gore to the game? More guts, more impact, more mess — or is it better when the horror stays a little... damp and implied?
We want to hear from you. Drop your thoughts on Discord or in the Steam forums!

🐟 COMMUNITY-DRIVEN FIXES & ADDITIONS

🎩 CUSTOMIZATION UNLOCKED
Bodies, hats, and titles are in. You finally get to look like the fisherman of your nightmares.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/5643a1334f3fa169ff7b029446356fae3f65baf5.gif

🛟 DROWNING IS A FEATURE NOW
 You can drown. Your friends can save you. Or not. Teamwork!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/2ce7d59d6210ee452024ae08156817301b7e3c01.gif

🐠 FISH MATTER NOW
 They’ve got rarities, personalities, values. No more four-eyed ghostfish. Also: the goofy ones stayed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/d55fd4145b48bd7ca995b14d0526fd55464d6bee.png

 🎨 NEW LOOK: CELL SHADING & CREEPY-CUTE VIBES
We’ve updated the art direction with cell shading — sharper silhouettes, bolder shapes, and more character across the board.
Monsters are scarier, fish are cuter, and your crewmates still look like they haven’t slept in days. Perfect.

🧭 MAPS, LIGHTHOUSES, SAFE ZONES
 New maps at every lighthouse and harbor. You can now respawn, sell, and sleep far from home  if you make it that far.

🚪 No More Quadruple Wishlist Portals
 Main menu buttons now behave like buttons. One click. One result. Magic.

📺 ONBOATING, In-Boat TVs, and Not Dying Immediately
 You asked for a gentler start. We added TVs, tutorials, and a few signs so your first hour isn’t your last.

🎣 FISHING GOT CLARITY
 "Catch" is now "Float." "Throw" is now "Cast." And we updated the mechanics. Still figuring it out. Still hard.

🚢 ENGINE & BOAT LOGIC
 The boat doesn’t drive away when you die. The engine doesn't explode during coffee breaks. And it gives you a warning before going kaput. Progress.

🦑 TENTACLES ARE REAL & THEY SLAP
 They’re visible. They’re synced. They slap, but don’t insta-kill. Growth!

🧠 YOU LOOK PEOPLE IN THE EYES NOW
 Characters track players. Mouths move when you scream. We added just enough uncanny valley to keep things spicy.

📻 NEW RADIO, NEW VIBES
 There’s a radio now. It does… something. We’re not telling. Go fiddle with it.

🪓 WHAT WE CUT (FOR NOW)
We "killed some darlings" to focus the chaos:

 Spearfishing 🪛
 Steven Seagull 🕊

They might return. Maybe worse. Maybe better. Probably worse.

❤️ THANK YOU, PLAYTESTERS
This upcoming patch is because of you. We’re grateful, we’re exhausted, and we’re still wildly behind on fish puns.
Join us the 23-25 of May :) 

 What you loved
 What you hated
 And if it’s time to add some blood to the brine

See you in the harbor. Just… don’t stay past nightfall.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/7a5e6670267a8bcbe6fe00dd38d0bed63a2fedd1.jpg
— Mana Brigade

notes.title: May Devlog: Fish Screams, Chaos Boats & Community Nightmares
notes.content:
Hey fishermen and fearseekers 👋
[previewyoutube=_Dszfhi8UBU;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s been a wild month out on the water, and we’ve got 10 new devlog updates straight from the depths of DREADLINE. Whether you were screaming in the last playtest or just lurking in the fog, here’s what you missed and what’s coming next.

🎤 Fish Voice Contest (Yes, Really)
WHAT NOISE DOES THIS FISH MAKE?
We’re letting you voice the fish. We're serious.

notes.title: Devlog April
notes.content:
Dreadline Devlog #1 – Playtest Recap & What’s Next

[previewyoutube=fU17owz7hsI;full][/previewyoutube]


Hey everyone! 👋

Welcome to our very first devlog for Dreadline. We recently wrapped up a playtest, and we wanted to take a moment to break down what we learned, the feedback we received, and where we’re heading next.
🎣 First off, thank you!
A huge shoutout to everyone who jumped in and helped us test the game. Seeing players explore the world we've built (and get spooked by our big fish monster) was incredible. Your feedback is already helping shape the future of Dreadline.
🐟 What’s Working

 The fishing gameplay and minigame mechanics got a big thumbs up—awesome news since that’s the heart of the game.
 The big monster encounters hit the mark (yes, it’s supposed to be that scary).
 The atmosphere? Chef’s kiss. Players really felt the tension and unease we were aiming for.

⚙️ Quality of Life Fixes Incoming
We’ve got some quick wins and planned tweaks on the way:

 A proper settings menu (including mouse sensitivity)
 VOIP controls yes, you’ll be able to mute it
 Motion sickness fixes we hear you and are working on smoothing things out
 Private lobbies 100% yes, coming soon
 Crouching and emotes on the wishlist, with emotes coming in a future sprint

🚢 Boat Life Updates
We’re expanding what life on your vessel looks like:

 More tools, creatures, and events on the boat
 Additional boat upgrades and eventual customization
 Better collision detection and improved boat physics
 Lures? Still debating. TBD!

👹 Monsters & Mechanics
Our deep-sea horrors are getting refined:

 More dramatic monster appearances with better telegraphing
 Diverse counterplay some monsters need brains, not brawn
 No more getting attacked while docked (oops!)
 Lifebuoys, spotlight mechanics, and yes more radio chatter

📈 Game Progression & Balance
We're dialing in the game's core loop:

 More fish types are on the way
 Quota system is evolving think somewhere between Lethal Company and Content Warning
 Showing fish value is under review we’re toying with keeping parts of the economy mysterious
 A day/night cycle is coming, and with it, new threats and flexible selling times
 Jump height = being fixed (no more low-orbit fishing)
 Engine breakdowns will tie into new boat interaction systems like a fusebox

💬 Final Thoughts
Just a reminder—this was a playtest, not a demo. We’re still in active development, and these sessions are key to making Dreadline the best it can be. If you played, we’d love to hear more from you. Your feedback is shaping the experience in real time.

Thanks again for joining us. Until next time, stay safe out on the water…

🧜‍♂️ You never know what’s lurking beneath.

💬 Like and follow for more updates. We’ll sea you next time... if you make it back to shore.

☀️Please help us spread the word about our game and join our Discord if you want to be a part of shaping the future of our game.
